description: This source file defines functions related to fetching and normalizing resident data within a frontend service layer. It includes a normalization function to standardize resident objects and an asynchronous API call to retrieve residents from an environment-configured backend or local mock data.

methods.name: normalizeResident(raw)
methods.description: Normalizes raw resident objects to a consistent shape used by the UI, handling various possible property names and ensuring required fields are present.

methods.name: getResidents()
methods.description: Fetches resident data from the backend API if configured, or returns mock data; processes the data through normalization before returning.
